CVE-2008-2266.title: uulib/uunconc.c in UUDeview 0.5.20, as used in nzbget before 0.3. ...
CVE-2008-2266.description: uulib/uunconc.c in UUDeview 0.5.20, as used in nzbget before 0.3.0 and possibly other products, allows local users to overwrite arbitrary files via a symlink attack on a temporary filename generated by the tempnam function.  NOTE: this may be a CVE-2004-2265 regression.
